semantic.justification: Actual original pooled item-holder/range owner with stable mutable endpoint lvalues, feature/edge/expandable flags, range movement/expansion/collapse and interval predicates. Original one-unit tab/line-break constructors set the feature flag; features never become expandable merely by enabling the independent bit. Original item-holder destruction and constructor constraints are retained. Rendering SetFont/other subtypes and complete EditEngine admission remain unported; no engine facade or raw-text replacement is supplied.
